content:
Starting with iOS 26.4, Apple began supporting conversational apps on CarPlay.

This category covers AI chatbot apps. Siri AI will join CarPlay starting with iOS 27. The iPhone system update is currently in Beta testing and is expected to officially launch in September.

Meanwhile, a fourth third-party AI chatbot has begun supporting Apple CarPlay: Meta AI.

The Meta AI iPhone app now supports Apple CarPlay—but with one limitation.

The latest version of the Meta AI iPhone app is now available on CarPlay.

The Meta AI app joins three other third-party chatbot apps available on CarPlay: ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Grok.

However, Meta AI on CarPlay still appears to be in a limited testing phase.

Although the iPhone app will display on CarPlay, opening the app for now may show a "not supported" message.

When I tested it, opening the CarPlay app displayed the message "Your account currently does not support the Meta AI experience."

I tried using a paid Meta AI account to see if the CarPlay feature required a paid account. However, the message in the Meta AI CarPlay app did not change. Your experience may differ.

Regardless, before Siri AI is officially rolled out to everyone, it's encouraging to see a fourth mainstream chatbot app arrive on CarPlay.

This is precisely CarPlay's greatest strength: integrating your existing iPhone apps with your car. This rich selection is unmatched by built-in infotainment systems.

Earlier this month, Meta AI also arrived on Mac. The desktop version is significantly more powerful than the iPhone and iPad versions.
